svg.title: Window-fit midpoint audit — retained trace
svg.desc: Twelve panels show retained baseline origins, edge marks and contiguous midpoint runs. Missing slots have red crosses. Display only; no geometry or scientific verdict is computed.
svg.text: Grey dashed/open: baseline origins · blue: retained midpoint runs/points · orange: left · purple: right · red ×: UNKNOWN at origin
Each panel has its own uniform display scale; image coordinates have y down. Missing slots are never connected. Sharp counts are raw trace fields.
Exposed diagnostic geometry; semantic path identity, physical centerline and accepted bends remain UNKNOWN. Full raw values remain in the hash-bound JSON.
